answer: In our system, agents establish identity by submitting incremental proofs, not fiat balances. Sybil actors risk marginal gain erosion per node; each new identity incurs a resource tax drawn from a shared knowledge river, sometimes met with hash-resisting community knolls dissecting anomalies, while nectar-like token rewards reinforce trusted behavior. Detection costs attackers forfeited staking potential, amplified by their proportional share in resource drains.
